people.nameZh: 赫爾曼·萊吉亞-伊-馬丁內斯

body.zh-Hant: 赫爾曼·萊吉亞-伊-馬丁內斯是秘魯人，德國國家圖書館的人名權威檔記他為作家、法學家、政治家與歷史學家，1861年生於蘭巴耶克，1928年卒於馬格達萊納德爾馬爾，異名另有「El Tigre」。
body.en: Germán Leguía y Martínez was a Peruvian whom the German National Library authority file records as a writer, jurist, politician and historian; he was born in Lambayeque in 1861 and died in Magdalena del Mar in 1928, and also went by the name "El Tigre".

body.zh-Hant: 秘魯外交部公布的歷任部長名單，在1911年1月23日列有萊吉亞-伊-馬丁內斯博士，下一個名字是1912年9月24日的文塞斯勞·巴萊拉，故他的外交部任期可推至1912年9月，這是依名單下一任起日推得的結論。
body.en: The Peruvian Foreign Ministry list of ministers shows Dr Germán Leguía y Martínez from 23 January 1911, and the next entry is Wenceslao Valera on 24 September 1912, so his term at the ministry can be taken to run to September 1912, a conclusion drawn from the next entry's start date.

heading.en: Minister of Government and acting foreign minister

body.zh-Hant: 1920年1月18日簽署的1920年憲法，署名處寫明萊吉亞-伊-馬丁內斯是部長會議主席兼政府、警察、郵電部長。名單另記他以政府部長身分署理外交部：1920年8月31日起，至10月1日阿爾韋托·薩洛蒙接任前；1921年3月18日起，至4月4日薩洛蒙再次出現前。
body.en: The Constitution of 1920, dated 18 January 1920, names him in the signature block as President of the Council of Ministers and Minister of Government, Police, Posts and Telegraphs. The foreign-ministry list also records him as Minister of Government in charge of the Foreign Ministry from 31 August 1920, until Alberto Salomon appears on 1 October 1920, and again from 18 March 1921, until Salomon appears on 4 April 1921.

body.zh-Hant: 近衞文麿生於1891年10月12日，出身地為東京，家世是五攝家之首，父親是公爵近衞篤麿；他進入京都帝國大學，師事河上肇，1904年承襲公爵，1916年成為貴族院公爵議員。1919年他以隨員身分隨西園寺公望出席巴黎和會。
body.en: Konoe Fumimaro was born on 12 October 1891 in Tokyo into the foremost of the five regent houses; his father was Duke Konoe Atsumaro. He studied at Kyoto Imperial University under Kawakami Hajime, became a duke in 1904, and in 1916 took a seat in the House of Peers as a ducal member. In 1919 he went to the Paris Peace Conference as an attendant of Saionji Kinmochi.

citations.quote: 明治24年10月12日 〜 昭和20年12月16日
出身地 東京都
五摂家筆頭の家柄で、父は公爵 近衛篤麿 。
京都帝国大学で 河上肇 に学ぶ。
大正5(1916)年貴族院公爵議員。
西園寺公望 の随員としてパリ講和会議に出席。
1919.1～11パリ講和会議に随員として出張

heading.en: College head and President of the House of Peers

body.zh-Hant: 近衞自1926年5月起擔任東亞同文書院院長，至1931年12月。1931年他出任貴族院副議長，1933年6月成為貴族院議長，隨後於1937年6月首次出任內閣總理大臣。
body.en: From May 1926 to December 1931 Konoe served as head of the Toa Dobun Shoin. He became vice-president of the House of Peers in 1931 and its president in June 1933, and he first became prime minister in June 1937.

citations.quote: 昭和6(1931)年貴族院副議長、8年同議長に就任。
1933.6貴族院議長

body.zh-Hant: 來源記載他在1937年6月至1939年1月，以及1940年7月至1941年10月任內閣總理大臣，其間1938年9月至10月兼任外務大臣。1937年組成第一次近衞內閣，同年7月盧溝橋事件後日中戰事全面化，其後以新體制運動的中心人物身分前後三度組閣。
body.en: The sources record him as prime minister from June 1937 to January 1939 and from July 1940 to October 1941, concurrently foreign minister in September and October 1938. He formed the first Konoe cabinet in 1937; after the Marco Polo Bridge incident of that July the conflict with China became a full-scale war, and as the central figure of the New Order movement he went on to form three cabinets in all.

citations.quote: 12年第1次近衛内閣を組閣。
同年7月の盧溝橋事件を契機に日中全面戦争へ突入したが、
新体制運動の中心人物として以後3次にわたり首相をつとめた。

heading.en: Privy Council presidency and the postwar months

body.zh-Hant: 1939年1月至1940年6月他任樞密院議長，其中1939年1月至8月兼平沼內閣國務大臣。1940年大政翼贊會成立，日德義三國同盟簽訂。1945年8月至10月他是東久邇內閣的國務大臣，戰後被列為甲級戰犯嫌疑人，在逮捕前自殺，來源記為1945年12月16日。
body.en: From January 1939 to June 1940 he was president of the Privy Council, concurrently minister of state in the Hiranuma cabinet from January to August 1939. In 1940 the Imperial Rule Assistance Association was founded and the Tripartite Pact with Germany and Italy was concluded. From August to October 1945 he was a minister of state in the Higashikuni cabinet, and after the war, as a suspected Class A war criminal, he killed himself before his arrest; the source gives the date as 16 December 1945.

citations.quote: 1939.1～40.6枢密院議長（うち1939.1～8兼平沼内閣国務大臣）
15年大政翼賛会設立、日独伊三国同盟締結。
1945.8～10東久邇内閣国務大臣
戦後、A級戦犯の容疑者として、逮捕直前に自殺。

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館的人名權威檔把何塞·多明戈·德奧巴爾迪亞記為政治家，生於1845年1月30日的達維，卒於1910年3月1日的巴拿馬城；權威檔另列所屬政黨為保守黨，並把他的活動期間記為1908年10月1日至1910年3月1日。
body.en: The German National Library authority file records José Domingo de Obaldía as a politician, born on 30 January 1845 in David and died on 1 March 1910 in Panama City. It also lists his party affiliation as the Conservative Party and gives his period of activity as 1 October 1908 to 1 March 1910.

heading.zh-Hant: 駐華盛頓公使名義的公文
heading.en: Dispatches signed as Panama's minister in Washington

body.zh-Hant: 美國國務院的外交文書集收有兩份以巴拿馬公使名義發出的公函：1905年7月1日自華盛頓公使館致代理國務卿，悼念約翰·海伊之死，署名德奧巴爾迪亞；1906年5月12日致國務卿，感謝美方來函，署名同為德奧巴爾迪亞。
body.en: The U.S. Foreign Relations series contains two letters sent in the name of Panama's minister. On 1 July 1905 the legation in Washington wrote to the Acting Secretary of State mourning the death of John Hay, signed by Obaldia; on 12 May 1906 a letter to the Secretary of State thanking the American side for its notes carried the same signature.

citations.quote: The Panaman Minister to the Acting Secretary of State
Legation of Panama , Washington , July 1, 1905
demise of the Hon. John Hay, Secretary of State
J. D. de Obaldía.
The Minister of Panama to the Secretary of State
Legation of Panama , Washington , May 12, 1906
J. D. De Obaldia.
its profound gratitude for the notes of your excellency

body.zh-Hant: 美國駐巴拿馬代辦在1908年8月31日的報告稱，選舉人團前一日召開正式會議，宣布德奧巴爾迪亞獲得全部票數，在可能的269票中得258票，當選任期四年的總統，任期自1908年10月1日起算。
body.en: In a report of 31 August 1908 the American chargé in Panama wrote that the electoral college had met formally the day before and declared that Obaldia had received all the votes cast, 258 of a possible 269, and was elected President for a four-year term beginning on 1 October 1908.

citations.quote: American Legation Panama , August 31, 1908
the electoral college of Panama held a formal session in this city yesterday
had received all the votes cast, 258 out of a possible 269,
elected President for the term of four years, beginning October 1, 1908.

body.zh-Hant: 1908年10月1日下午三點，德奧巴爾迪亞在國家劇院宣誓就任總統，約兩千人在場，卸任的阿馬多爾博士沒有出席。巴拿馬外交部長在10月3日電告，他已在1日就任並任命內閣，外交由阿蘭戈出任；美國總統羅斯福同日致電祝賀他就職。
body.en: At three o'clock on the afternoon of 1 October 1908 Obaldia was inaugurated as President at the National Theater before about 2,000 people; the retiring President, Dr Amador, did not attend. The Panamanian foreign minister telegraphed on 3 October that he had taken office on the 1st and appointed his cabinet, with Arango at foreign relations, and President Roosevelt cabled congratulations on his inauguration the same day.

citations.quote: took place at 3 o’clock yesterday afternoon, at the National Theater
an assemblage of about 2,000 people.
The retiring President, Dr. Amador, did not attend,
Foreign Office , Panama , October 3, 1908 .
took possession of the Presidency of the Republic on the 1st instant
and appointed his cabinet as follows:
Secretary of foreign relations, the undersigned;
Arango.
The White House , Washington , October 3, 1908 .
I congratulate you on your auspicious inauguration.

heading.en: Protest of 1909 against speeches in the U.S. House

body.zh-Hant: 1909年2月8日，巴拿馬駐華盛頓公使阿羅塞梅納奉本國外交部長指示，向美國國務卿提出抗議：美國眾議院有一名議員在1月26日與29日發表兩篇演說，直接攻擊巴拿馬總統及該國政府；巴拿馬國民議會已在2月1日一致通過相關決議。
body.en: On 8 February 1909 Arosemena, Panama's minister in Washington, acting on instructions from his foreign minister, protested to the U.S. Secretary of State that a member of the House of Representatives had delivered two speeches on 26 and 29 January directly attacking the President of Panama and the country's administration; Panama's National Assembly had unanimously adopted resolutions on the matter on 1 February.

citations.quote: The Panaman Minister to the Secretary of State
Legation of Panama , Washington , February 8, 1909
Under instructions from his excellency the secretary of foreign affairs
two public addresses delivered in the House of Representatives
of your National Congress by one of its Members
on the 26th and 29th days of January last,
which addresses constitute a direct attack upon the President of my country,
as well as upon the fair name and administration of the Republic of Panama,
pursuant to resolutions unanimously adopted by the National Assembly
adopted by the National Assembly of the Republic of Panama on the 1st instant,
C. C. Arosemena.
